selection.mask: Minimum equal-cell mean periodic BLER over all frontends, conditions and DEV cases; each frontend/condition clean BLER <= legacy +0.01; stable list-order ties
selection.policy: Lowest mean RF calls satisfying all three bounds in EVERY frontend x condition x DEV case against guarded periodic with the selected mask. No averaging frontends for eligibility. Periodic is guaranteed fallback.
selection.crc_undetected_rule: No extra observed undetected CRC-accepted wrong deliveries versus matched periodic in any DEV cell

rs.packet_phase: Uniform 0..2039 symbols independently per stream; same for all methods

receiver.refinement: Per-block RMS >2*block median, restricted to legacy symbol flags; erase codeword byte iff >=2 flags; original byte grid
receiver.confirm8: After changed action, confidence<0.75, or an armed change event, request the next two block-end decisions; every call charged
receiver.rule: Persistent fast ALE; block energy-ratio gate >0.25; relative pulse masking; no classifier
receiver.state: Reset only between independent streams; never at packets or jammer transitions

limitations: Simulation, BPSK, ideal symbol/codeword synchronization; not a complete RF link
No hardware energy or deployment assertion
Block-median refinement buffers up to 5 ms; codewords need 20.4 ms assembly plus remaining block time
Feature and duplicate decoder work shared by harness; timing is not per-device energy
DEV tolerances are selection rules, not a formal noninferiority test
V3 observed panel excluded from selection and test; new namespace and training seeds
